verses.tl: La-allaka baakhi'un nafsaka allaa yakoonoo mu'mineen
In nasha nunazzil alayhim minas-samaa'i aayatan fazallat a'naaquhum lahaa khaadi'een
Wa maa ya'teehim min dhikrin minar-Rahmaani muhdathin illaa kaanoo anhu mu'rideen
Faqad kadhdhaboo fasaya'teehim anbaa'u maa kaanoo bihi yastahzi'oon
Awalam yaraw ilal-ardi kam anbatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem
Inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan wa maa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
Wa idh naadaa rabbuka moosaa ani-til-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Qaala rabbi innee akhaafu an yukadhdhiboon
Wa yadeequ sadree wa laa yantaliqu lisaanee fa-arsil ilaa haaroon
Wa lahum alayya dhanbun fa-akhaafu an yaqtuloon
Qaala kallaa fadhhabaa bi-aayaatinaa innaa ma'akum mustami'oon
Fa'tiyaa fir'awna faqoolaa innaa rasoolu rabbil-aalameen
Qaala alam nurabbika feenaa waleedan wa labithta feenaa min umurika sineen
Wa fa-alta fa'latakal-latee fa-alta wa anta minal-kaafireen
Qaala fa-altuhaa idhan wa anaa minad-daalleen
Fafarartu minkum lammaa khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukman wa ja'alanee minal-mursaleen
Wa tilka ni'matun tamunnuhaa alayya an abbadta banee israa'eel
Qaala rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa baynahumaa in kuntum mooqineen
Qaala inna rasoolakumul-ladhee ursila ilaykum lamajnoon
Qaala rabbul-mashriqi wal-maghribi wa maa baynahumaa in kuntum ta'qiloon
Qaala la-ini ittakhadhta ilahan ghayree la-aj'alannaka minal-masjooneen
Qaala fa'ti bihi in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Fa-alqaa asaahu fa-idhaa hiya thu'baanun mubeen
Wa naza'a yadahu fa-idhaa hiya baydaa'u lin-naazireen
Qaala lilmala'i hawlahu inna haadhaa lasaahirun aleem
Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihi famaadhaa ta'muroon
Qaaloo arjihi wa akhaahu wab'ath fil-madaa'ini haashireen
Wa qeela lin-naasi hal antum mujtami'oon
Falammaa jaa'as-saharatu qaaloo lifir'awna a'inna lanaa la-ajran in kunnaa nahnul-ghaalibeen
Qaala na'am wa innakum idhan laminal-muqarrabeen
Qaala lahum moosaa alqoo maa antum mulqoon
Fa-alqaw hibaalahum wa isiyyahum wa qaaloo bi-izzati fir'awna innaa lanahnul-ghaaliboon
Fa-alqaa moosaa asaahu fa-idhaa hiya talqafu maa ya'fikoon
Qaala aamantum lahu qabla an aadhana lakum innahu lakabeerukumul-ladhee allamakumus-sihra falasawfa ta'lamoona la-uqatti'anna aydiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafin wa la-usallibannakum ajma'een
Qaaloo laa dayra innaa ilaa rabbinaa munqaliboon
Innaa natma'u an yaghfira lanaa rabbunaa khataayaanaa an kunnaa awwalal-mu'mineen
Wa awhaynaa ilaa moosaa an asri bi-ibaadee innakum muttaba'oon
Falammaa taraa'al-jam'aani qaala ashaabu moosaa innaa lamudrakoon
Qaala kallaa inna ma'iya rabbee sayahdeen
Fa-awhaynaa ilaa moosaa anid-rib bi-asaakal-bahra fanfalaqa fakaana kullu firqin kat-tawdil-azeem
Wa anjaynaa moosaa wa man ma'ahu ajma'een
Inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan wa maa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
Idh qaala li-abeehi wa qawmihi maa ta'budoon
Qaaloo na'budu asnaaman fanazallu lahaa aakifeen
Qaaloo bal wajadnaa aabaa'anaa kadhaalika yaf'aloon
Wal-ladhee atma'u an yaghfira lee khatee'atee yawmad-deen
Rabbi hab lee hukman wa alhiqnee bis-saaliheen
Yawma laa yanfa'u maalun wa laa banoon
Illaa man ataa Allaaha biqalbin saleem
Wa qeela lahum ayna maa kuntum ta'budoon
Min doonillaahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroon
Ta-Allaahi in kunnaa lafee dalaalin mubeen
Falaw anna lanaa karratan fanakoona minal-mu'mineen
Inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan wa maa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
Idh qaala lahum akhoohum noohun alaa tattaqoon
Wa maa as'alukum alayhi min ajrin in ajree illaa alaa rabbil-aalameen
Qaala wa maa ilmee bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
In hisaabuhum illaa alaa rabbee law tash'uroon
Qaaloo la-in lam tantahi yaa noohu latakoonanna minal-marjoomeen
Faftah baynee wa baynahum fathan wa najjinee wa man ma'ee minal-mu'mineen
Inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan wa maa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
Idh qaala lahum akhoohum hoodun alaa tattaqoon
Wa maa as'alukum alayhi min ajrin in ajree illaa alaa rabbil-aalameen
Innee akhaafu alaykum adhaaba yawmin azeem
Qaaloo sawaa'un alaynaa awa'azta am lam takun minal-waa'izeen
Fakadhdhaboohu fa-ahlaknaahum inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan wa maa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
Idh qaala lahum akhoohum saalihun alaa tattaqoon
Wa maa as'alukum alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illaa alaa rabbil-aalameen
Wa zuroo'in wa nakhlin tal'uhaa hadeem
Al-ladheena yufsidoona fil-ardi wa laa yuslihoon
Maa anta illaa basharun mithlunaa fa'ti bi-aayatin in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Qaala haadhihi naaqatun lahaa shirbun wa lakum shirbu yawmin ma'loom
Wa laa tamassoohaa bisoo'in faya'khudhakum adhaabu yawmin azeem
Fa-akhadhahumul-adhaabu inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan wa maa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
Idh qaala lahum akhoohum lootun alaa tattaqoon
Wa maa as'alukum alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illaa alaa rabbil-aalameen
Wa tadharoona maa khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwaajikum bal antum qawmun aadoon
Qaaloo la-in lam tantahi yaa lootu latakoonanna minal-mukhrajeen
Rabbi najjinee wa ahlee mimmaa ya'maloon
Wa amtarnaa alayhim mataran fasaa'a matarul-mundhareen
Inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan wa maa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
Idh qaala lahum shu'aybun alaa tattaqoon
Wa maa as'alukum alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illaa alaa rabbil-aalameen
Wa laa tabkhasun-naasa ashyaa'ahum wa laa ta'thaw fil-ardi mufsideen
Wa maa anta illaa basharun mithlunaa wa in nazunnuka laminal-kaadhibeen
Fa-asqit alaynaa kisafan minas-samaa'i in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Fakadhdhaboohu fa-akhadhahum adhaabu yawmiz-zullati innahu kaana adhaaba yawmin azeem
Inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan wa maa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
Awalam yakun lahum aayatan an ya'lamahu ulamaa'u banee israa'eel
Faqara'ahu alayhim maa kaanoo bihi mu'mineen
Laa yu'minoona bihi hattaa yaraw al-adhaabal-aleem
Faya'tiyahum baghtatan wa hum laa yash'uroon
Maa aghnaa anhum maa kaanoo yumatta'oon
Wa maa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa lahaa mundhiroon
Wa maa yanbaghee lahum wa maa yastatee'oon
Falaa tad'u ma'a Allaahi ilahan aakhara fatakoona minal-mu'adhdhabeen
Fa-in asawka faqul innee baree'un mimmaa ta'maloon
Alam taraa annahum fee kulli waadin yaheemoon
Wa annahum yaqooloona maa laa yaf'aloon
Illal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati wa dhakaroo Allaaha katheeran wantasaroo min ba'di maa zulimoo wa saya'lamul-ladheena zalamoo ayya munqalabin yanqaliboon
